capabilities: calculate Performance Points for notes via a ribbon and command
score notes on readability, complexity, and information
view a history of previously calculated values
switch between Performance Points system versions in settings
disambiguation: Not a performance-optimization tool despite its name; it calculates osu!-style Performance Points to gamify note-taking.
extras: README states the project is no longer maintained; changelog and Performance Points documentation are only available via external links, and support is handled through a Discord-style server and email.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to gamify note-taking with a scoring metric that rewards writing activity.

relations.evidence: integrates the Performance Points system from the rhythm game osu! straight to Obsidian

summary: Gamification plugin that scores notes with an osu!-style Performance Points system based on readability, complexity, and information.
